intro: From April 22 to August 20, 2026, ZCyberNews published 20 articles under the Unit 42 tag, covering 16 high-severity and 2 critical incidents. The reporting identified APT29, CL-STA-1062, and Gremlin Stealer as distinct threat actors. Affected sectors included technology, software development, enterprise, financial services, and government, with global impact and specific incidents in Central America, North America, South America, and South Asia.
